headline: Magic Carpet flies its full forty-five worlds
lede: The campaign now runs the original's complete length — fifteen arcs, five SKY finales, and the economy law proven honest all the way to the last vault. The tick cap grew too, from a measurement rather than a guess.

notes.text: Eighteen new worlds (GREENVEIL to THE FINAL SKY) keep every house law: the green/ember/frost atmosphere cycle, the +15 vault ramp, +5 pearls per world. The deepest ask — 805 mana — sits at 87.5% of what the pearls realistically pay, a better margin than mid-campaign, so the campaign reaches 45 without bending the economy policy that stopped earlier growth plans.

The 60-seed balance sweep at 45 worlds wins 60/60, but its slowest seed needed 1,217,880 ticks — over the inherited cap of 1.17M. Deep-arc wizard fights lengthen superlinearly (725 HP at world 45), so the cap factor rose to 30k/world and moved into sim.js as the single source both the harness and the debug solver read — literal caps that drift apart were a known failure mode.

The harness now proves the ramp all the way to world 45 instead of stopping at the old boundary, pins all five SKY finale names by index, and re-proved cursor wrap generically at n=45. Two mutations tested: truncating the table or slowing one pearl step each reddens exactly one pin.
